name: withholding_settlement_refund_or_balance
question_template: Apply only this fictional scenario-local tax policy. Taxable income in USD is {INC}. Flat tax ratio is {RATE}. Tax withheld during the year in USD is {WH}. Tax liability equals taxable income times the ratio. Year-end settlement equals withheld minus liability; a positive value is a refund due, a negative value is a balance owed. Use exact arithmetic and round only the final settlement half up to two decimals. Report the tax liability.

slots.description: Tax liability before any withholding credit.

program:
def solve():
    inc = P["INC"]
    rate = P["RATE"]
    wh = P["WH"]
    liability = inc * rate
    settlement = wh - liability
    return {"final": settlement, "tax_liability_usd": liability}
